system_design_insights: push_files works for batches but must be sequential — parallel pushes cause 422 fast-forward errors
GitHub API blocks workflow file creation (403) — .github/workflows/*.yml must be created via VS Code or git CLI
60KB files push fine solo via push_files as single-file batch
Condensed docs vs verbatim trade-off — large files pushed as summaries due to API constraints
